@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The firefighter was awarded a medal for his b______y. He had gone into a burning house and rescued a baby.
= bravery
~詞義 bravery（n.）勇氣;勇敢
~原文 The firefighter was awarded a medal for his bravery. He had gone into a burning house and rescued a baby.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Little Johnny d______es all vegetables. He refuses to eat any of them.
= dislikes
~詞義 dislike（v.）討厭
~原文 Little Johnny dislikes all vegetables. He refuses to eat any of them.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The weather in Los Angeles is dry and warm in the summer, with only o______l showers.
= occasional
~詞義 occasional（adj.）偶爾的
~原文 The weather in Los Angeles is dry and warm in the summer, with only occasional showers.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The store clerk remained patient even when a c______r complained loudly about the service.
= customer
~詞義 customer（n.）顧客
~原文 The store clerk remained patient even when a customer complained loudly about the service.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Many citizens expressed their concerns about how the g______t was handling environmental issues.
= government
~詞義 government（n.）政府
~原文 Many citizens expressed their concerns about how the government was handling environmental issues.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: It is easy to spoil a relationship, but it is very difficult to ______ one.
A: tease
B: scrub
C: mend
D: hug
= C
~詞義 mend（v.）修補
~原文 It is easy to spoil a relationship, but it is very difficult to mend one.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Our company provides the best possible service to our ______, and that is why many of them have been with us for many years.
A: lords
B: beads
C: clients
D: feathers
= C
~詞義 client（n.）客戶
~原文 Our company provides the best possible service to our clients, and that is why many of them have been with us for many years.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The tired worker took a break and went out to smoke a ______.
A: timber
B: feather
C: cigarette
D: lollipop
= C
~詞義 cigarette（n.）香菸
~原文 The tired worker took a break and went out to smoke a cigarette.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: On the table in the middle of the dining room is a ______ holding several red roses.
A: pine
B: vase
C: mop
D: hell
= B
~詞義 vase（n.）花瓶
~原文 On the table in the middle of the dining room is a vase holding several red roses.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Mr. Lee took his children to the ______ on Sunday. They especially liked the clown and the magic tricks that he performed.
A: occasion
B: tobacco
C: circus
D: lifetime
= C
~詞義 circus（n.）馬戲團
~原文 Mr. Lee took his children to the circus on Sunday. They especially liked the clown and the magic tricks that he performed.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: beast
B: monk
C: lighthouse
D: enjoyable
E: occasion
F: brass

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The weekend hike was so ______ that the couple planned to visit the same place again next month.
= D
~詞義 enjoyable（adj.）令人愉快的
~原文 The weekend hike was so enjoyable that the couple planned to visit the same place again next month.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ______ is highly respected in this village, and many people go to him for life advice.
= B
~詞義 monk（n.）僧侶
~原文 The monk is highly respected in this village, and many people go to him for life advice.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ______ shone its light out to sea, guiding ships away from danger.
= C
~詞義 lighthouse（n.）燈塔
~原文 The lighthouse shone its light out to sea, guiding ships away from danger.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The hunter followed the trail of the ______ and finally killed it.
= A
~詞義 beast（n.）野獸
~原文 The hunter followed the trail of the beast and finally killed it.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The earrings look expensive, but they are actually made of ______.
= F
~詞義 brass（n.）黃銅
~原文 The earrings look expensive, but they are actually made of brass.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: hugged
B: lifetime
C: hell
D: governed
E: unacceptable
F: feathers

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: One way to distinguish between male and female birds is to look at their ______. Often males have colorful ones while females don't.
= F
~詞義 feather（n.）羽毛
~原文 One way to distinguish between male and female birds is to look at their feathers. Often males have colorful ones while females don't.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The elderly woman was presented with an award for a(n) ______ of helping the poor.
= B
~詞義 lifetime（n.）一生
~原文 The elderly woman was presented with an award for a(n) lifetime of helping the poor.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: John found it ______ that people kept spreading rumors without checking the facts first.
= E
~詞義 unacceptable（adj.）無法接受的
~原文 John found it unacceptable that people kept spreading rumors without checking the facts first.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: There is no way for people to know for sure whether heaven and ______ exist or where they are.
= C
~詞義 hell（n.）地獄
~原文 There is no way for people to know for sure whether heaven and hell exist or where they are.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The mayor has ______ his city well, and many citizens support him loyally.
= D
~詞義 govern（v.）治理
~原文 The mayor has governed his city well, and many citizens support him loyally.
